data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to receive shared photos, videos, text, URLs, or files from other apps.
data.what_it_does: It listens for share intents on Android and iOS, exposing the received media as a stream and initial payload. It supports a wide range of MIME types and can be configured to auto‑redirect to the host app.
use_when: Implementing a share extension to accept content from other apps
Handling incoming files or URLs in a Flutter app
Building a photo or document sharing feature
avoid_when: You only need to share content from your app
You are targeting a single platform without native intent handling
strengths: Supports Android and iOS with extensive MIME type coverage
Provides both initial payload and continuous stream of shared items
Allows disabling auto‑redirect for custom flow
weaknesses: Requires native configuration in AndroidManifest and iOS Share Extension
Setup is more involved than simple plugins
Documentation is limited to README and changelog
data.setup_notes: Add intent filters to AndroidManifest.xml, request READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission, create an iOS Share Extension, configure Info.plist, and set AppGroupId.

alternatives.name: receive_sharing_intent
alternatives.why_pick_it: Original plugin providing the same functionality; this fork adds extra PRs and fixes.
